yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-approval
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: before
      run: echo before-gate
    - name: gate
      approval:
        message: edge-campaign gate
        timeoutMinutes: 10
    - name: after
      run: echo after-gate
